reviewer_rule: Each key area must explain role, movement, public room, ground floor, blue-green, AI backstage, bypass, evidence status within 30 seconds.

areas.review_question_zh: 高风险AI能力如何在不打断普通城市生活的前提下被验证？
areas.review_question_en: How can higher-risk AI capabilities be tested without interrupting ordinary urban life?
areas.urban_form: Large research clusters + shared verification courtyards + porous public edge + controlled internal test yards

spatial_rooms.role: public-facing research commons; non-AI circulation remains open
time/space bounded experiments with physical Human Stop and safety buffer
professional review, evidence gate, audit and capability registry interface
continuous pedestrian/service route independent from test operations

areas.movement: Capability Backbone + derived cross-axis; ordinary pedestrian/service bypass must remain continuous; Fifth Ring connection remains evidence-required study task.
areas.ground_floor: Open commons and shared services on public edge; controlled labs/test interfaces deeper inside; no requirement for universal open ground floor.
areas.blue_green: Shared courtyards, shade, stormwater landscape and future building-green-water integration; exact water/engineering interfaces remain unknown.
areas.ai_backstage: AI equipment remains inside controlled test/service layers; public realm is readable without AI.
areas.non_ai_baseline: ordinary path, signage, shade, lighting, manual safety control, physical stop and emergency access

areas.review_question_zh: 高校、人才与社区如何共享同一套低扰动公共服务空间？
areas.review_question_en: How can universities, talent and neighborhoods share low-disturbance public-service space?
areas.urban_form: Fine-grain renewal + campus-neighborhood stitches + service courtyards + gradual scale transition

spatial_rooms.role: shared learning, developer community and civic-service interface
accessible routes, manual service baseline, elderly/digital-exclusion support
research task connecting station walksheds to neighborhood public life; exact host unverified

areas.movement: Walk-first campus/community stitches; Wudaokou and Qinghuadongluxikou TOD links remain research tasks pending official/verified conditions.
areas.ground_floor: Frequent entrances, community services, learning spaces and transparent civic edges; retain non-digital/manual service routes.
areas.blue_green: Shade, small courtyards, comfortable walking and micro-climate adaptation integrated with daily use.
areas.ai_backstage: Ambient low-risk support by default; personalization/recognition only in active Consent Layer.
areas.non_ai_baseline: physical accessibility, ordinary wayfinding, manual help, fixed opening/service information, conventional emergency routes

areas.review_question_zh: AI-native服务如何在真实商业、通勤、骑手与夜间公共生活中被检验？
areas.review_question_en: How can AI-native services be tested within real commerce, commuting, delivery and night-time public life?
areas.urban_form: Small blocks + continuous active frontage + multiple entrances + market-street public rooms + night-friendly edges

spatial_rooms.role: review frame for cross-station/road pedestrian continuity; not an approved crossing
mixed commerce, delivery management, public service and AI-native business validation
safe return, lighting, seating and ordinary social life before digital services
bike parking, static transport, shade and planned-green multifunction study

areas.movement: Dense walking network + cycling/static-transport management + derived east-west stitch; exact road redline/crossing remains evidence-required.
areas.ground_floor: Continuous but varied active frontage, multiple entries, delivery/service pockets, night-time public lighting and seating.
areas.blue_green: Planned-green multifunction study, shade and comfortable market/public-space interfaces; legal green-space status must be verified.
areas.ai_backstage: Service orchestration supports merchants/users but never replaces ordinary transactions, navigation, lighting or help channels.
areas.non_ai_baseline: ordinary commerce/service, visible wayfinding, staffed help, conventional payment/process where applicable, safe walking and lighting
evidence_notes: four-quadrant connection is a study task
